Valid Value Set.description: The valid value set/definition that defines the allowed values for this element (ValidValuesAssignment relationship).

Element Id.description: The unique identifier (qualified name or GUID) of the element being referenced.

Reference Value.description: The valid value definition supplying the reference/tag value (ReferenceValueAssignment relationship).

Effective From.description: The beginning of when an element is viewable.

Effective Time.description: The time at which an element must be effective in order to be returned by the request.

Effective To.description: The ending time at which an element is visible.

Extended Properties.description: A dictionary of properties that extend the properties of an entity type.

External Source GUID.description: The unique identifier of an external source.

External Source Name.description: The name of an external source

For Duplicate Processing.description: Flag indicating if the request is to support duplicate processing.

For Lineage.description: Flag indicating if the request is to support lineage.

Journal Entry.description: A text entry into a journal.

Request ID.description: A user provided or system generated request id for a conversation.

Preferred Value.description: The preferred value -- the value itself, as stored and exchanged. For Setup/Clear Valid Metadata commands, the value being set up for the property (or map name/value); required there unless a Metadata Value Table is given.

Glossary Term.description: Term that provides meaning to this field.

Is Own Anchor.description: A flag indicating if the element is its own anchor or is anchored to a different element.

Merge Update.description: A flag indicating if the update should be a merge or replace.

Parent at End1.description: A flag indicating if the parent is at end1 of the relationship

Parent Relationship Attributes.description: A dictionary of relationship attributes to establish the parent relationship.

Status.description: Repository or element header status for an element.

Zone Membership.description: Zones scope visibility of elements to different users.

Additional Properties.description: Additional Properties  allow arbitrary properties not defined in the type definitions to be added to any referenceable element.

Category.description: A user-defined category for the element, used to group related elements for display or search purposes.

Confidence Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, level_identifier: int}. level_identifier uses ConfidenceLevel enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, AD_HOC=1, TRANSACTIONAL=2, AUTHORITATIVE=3, DERIVED=4, OBSOLETE=5, OTHER=99.

Confidentiality Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, level_identifier: int}. level_identifier uses ConfidentialityLevel enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, INTERNAL=1, CONFIDENTIAL=2, SENSITIVE=3, RESTRICTED=4, OTHER=99.

Criticality Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, level_identifier: int}. level_identifier uses CriticalityLevel enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, MARGINAL=1, IMPORTANT=2, CRITICAL=3, CATASTROPHIC=4, OTHER=99.

Display Name.description: The common name of an element.

GUID.description: A unique identifier - typically of an element in this context.

Impact Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, severity_identifier: int}. severity_identifier uses ImpactSeverity enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, LOW=1, MEDIUM=2, HIGH=3, OTHER=99.

Legal.description: Copyright and/or license information for the element or associated resource.

Policy Management Point.description: Combined classification from 0435. Applied to Referenceable. Structure: {point_type: str, name: str, description: str}. point_type is one of: PolicyAdministrationPoint, PolicyDecisionPoint, PolicyEnforcementPoint, PolicyInformationPoint, PolicyRetrievalPoint. A Referenceable may have multiple policy management point classifications simultaneously.

Qualified Name.description: The unique, text name of an element.

Retention Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, basis_identifier: int, associated_guid: str, archive_after: date, delete_after: date}. basis_identifier uses RetentionBasis enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, TEMPORARY=1, PROJECT_LIFETIME=2, TEAM_LIFETIME=3, CONTRACT_LIFETIME=4, REGULATED_LIFETIME=5, TIMEBOXED_LIFETIME=6, OTHER=99.

Security Tags.description: Optional security tags for security processing.

Content Status.description: The lifecycle status of an element.

User Defined Content Status.description: A user defined content status = only valid if content status is OTHER.

Data Type.description: The data type of the field or value specification (e.g. string, int, date, boolean).

Usage.description: The usage guidance for this element — how it is intended to be used in context.

Scope.description: Scope of the definition or element.

Namespace Path.description: The namespace path that qualifies the element's name within a larger naming hierarchy.

Is Case Sensitive.description: If true, values for this data class or field are case-sensitive.

Confidence.description: A percent confidence in the proposed adding of the member.

Steward.description: The identifier of the steward responsible for the element.

Steward Type Name.description: The type name of the steward element.

Steward Property Name.description: Property name used to identify the type of the steward.

Notes.description: Notes and observations about the element.

Implementation Element.description: The element (e.g. a deployed capability, process, or connector) that implements the Design Element.
Implementation Element.Journal Entry: Added 2026-09-13 -- ImplementedBy relationship (0737) support, requested by the user: Solution Architect had no command for governance_officer's linkDesignToImplementation/detachDesignFromImplementation, and Create Information Supply Chain had no way to record implementation elements. Confirmed live 2026-09-13 that 'Link Information Supply Chain Child' already correctly uses CollectionMembership (not ImplementedBy) -- no fix needed there. Detach/Unlink/Attach/Add/Remove variants are auto-derived by build_command_variants() from this one 'Link' definition, matching every other Solution Architect link command -- no separate Detach compact entry needed.

Ordinal.description: Position of this value in an ordered list of values (the ordinal property).

In Reference Data Set.description: The reference data set this value belongs to. Links the value as a member of the set (ValidValueMember).

Is Default Member.description: If true, this value is the set's default (isDefaultValue on the ValidValueMember relationship).

Member Ordinal.description: Position of the value within the set (ordinal on the ValidValueMember relationship).

Members.description: Existing values that belong to this set, one per line or comma-separated. Each is linked as a member (ValidValueMember). On a re-run, a value no longer listed is unlinked, not deleted.

Values.description: Member values to create and link, one per line. Commas are part of the value. Each value's qualified name is the set's qualified name plus '::' and the value, so a re-run reuses it. Ordinal follows list position.

Value Table.examples:
| Value | Display Name | Default |
|---|---|---|
| PENDING | Pending | true |
Value Table.description: Member values to create or update and link, as a markdown table with a header row. Columns: Value (required), Display Name, Description, Usage, Data Type, Is Case Sensitive, Default, Ordinal. Use \| for a literal pipe.

Default Member.description: Which entry in Values is the set's default (match on the value).

Member Value.description: The value that is a member of the set (end 2 of ValidValueMember).

Valid Value 1.description: The first valid value in the relationship.

Valid Value 2.description: The second valid value in the relationship.

Valid Value.description: The valid value being implemented (end 1 of ValidValuesImplementation).

Association Name.description: Name of the association between the two valid values.

Association Type.description: Type of the association between the two valid values.

Association Description.description: Description of how the two valid values map to each other.

Symbolic Name.description: The symbolic name the implementing element uses for this valid value.

Implementation Value.description: The value the implementing element uses to represent this valid value.

Additional Values.description: Other values the implementing element uses for this valid value, as name/value pairs.

Strict Requirement.description: If true, the element must use one of the set's values; if false, the values are suggestions (strictRequirement on ValidValuesAssignment).

Attribute Name.description: The attribute of the element that the reference value applies to.

Link Element to Valid Values.description: Link any element to the ValidValueSet defining its allowed values (generic ValidValuesAssignment relationship, for elements outside the Question/Data Field families).

Detach Element from Valid Values.description: Remove the generic ValidValuesAssignment relationship between an element and its ValidValueSet.

Link Reference Value Assignment.description: Tag an element (for example, a survey result Annotation) with a resolved valid value classification (ReferenceValueAssignment relationship).

Detach Reference Value Assignment.description: Remove a ReferenceValueAssignment relationship from an element.

Create Reference Data Set.description: Creates or updates a reference data set -- a named list of allowed values, such as order statuses or country codes. Members can be linked (Members), created inline one per line (Values), or created with their own properties from a table (Value Table).

Create Reference Data Value.description: Creates or updates a single reference data value, optionally adding it to a reference data set.

Link Valid Value Member.description: Links a value as a member of a reference data set (or any valid value set) (ValidValueMember relationship).

Link Consistent Valid Values.description: Links two valid values that are consistent with each other (used together) (ConsistentValidValues relationship).

Link Associated Valid Values.description: Links two related valid values, with a named association (ValidValueAssociation relationship).

Link Mapped Valid Values.description: Links two valid values that mean the same thing in different sets (ValidValuesMapping relationship).

Link Valid Value Implementation.description: Links a valid value to the element that implements it, with the symbolic name and value it uses (ValidValuesImplementation relationship).
